title: Local Policy Manifolds for Efficient Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2506.04022v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) aims at optimising several, often conflicting goals to improve the flexibility and reliability of RL in practical tasks. This is typically achieved by finding a set of diverse, non-dominated policies that form a Pareto front in the performance space. However, constructing such a policy set remains computationally demanding, as it requires finding not a single optimal policy, but a set of policies to cover a wide range of trade-offs among the objectives. We introduce LLE-MORL, an approach that traces policy manifolds by utilising the local relationship between the high-dimensional policy parameter space and the performance space. This structured representation enables an efficient search within contiguous solution domains via locally linear extrapolation, allowing for the rapid generation of high-quality solutions without extensive retraining. translated_title: 用于高效多目标强化学习的局部策略流形
translated_abstract: 多目标强化学习（MORL）旨在优化多个经常相互冲突的目标，以提高强化学习在实际任务中的灵活性和可靠性。这通常通过寻找一组多样化的、非支配的策略来实现，这些策略在性能空间中构成帕累托前沿。然而，构建这样的策略集在计算上代价高昂，因为它需要找到的不是一个单一的最优策略，而是一组能够覆盖目标之间广泛权衡范围的策略集合。我们提出了LLE-MORL，一种通过利用高维策略参数空间与性能空间之间的局部关系来追踪策略流形的方法。这种结构化表示使得算法能够通过局部线性外推在连续解域内进行高效搜索，从而无需大量重新训练即可快速生成高质量解。我们还对该方法提供了理论分析。
tldr: 提出LLE-MORL方法，通过利用策略参数空间与性能空间之间的局部关系追踪策略流形，借助局部线性外推实现高效搜索，无需大量重新训练即可快速生成覆盖多目标权衡的高质量策略集合。
en_tdlr: LLE-MORL traces policy manifolds by exploiting the local relationship between the high-dimensional policy parameter space and the performance space, enabling efficient search via locally linear extrapolation to rapidly generate high-quality solutions without extensive retraining.
